test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: For what value of p does the system of equations 18x + 36y + 45 = 0 and px - 54y + 67 = 0 have no solution?
solution:
Given:

1st equation = 18x + 36y + 45 = 0

2nd equation = px - 54y + 67 = 0

Concept used:

If an equation has no solutions then

a1x + b1y + c1 = 0 ; a2x + b2y + c2 = 0

⇒ a1/a2 = b1/b2 ≠ c1/c2

Calculation:

⇒ a1/a2 = b1/b2 

⇒ 18/p = 36/(-54)

⇒ p = (18 × - 54))/36

⇒ p = - 27

∴ The correct answer is - 27.
